## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Columbus, United States. It starts at 157 Easton Town Center.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Everyone played with Lego growing up, and now, over 50 years since the brand's inception, LEGOLAND Discovery Center is pushing the limits of the world's favorite toy.
>
> There are 10 family attractions at LEGOLAND Discovery Center Columbus, a homage to all things colorful, and brick-like! Watch your helmet-haired friends in action in the 4D cinema, and let the kids run wild in the super-fun LEGO City play area. You can also see the highlights of Columbus, Cleveland, and Cincinnati in miniature!

## Where this page comes from
